entries.name: VetDoest (Veterinary Practice Doest)
entries.duty: Front desk Mon-Fri 9:00-14:00, Sat 9:00-13:00, closed Sunday. By appointment only; house visits Tuesdays and Fridays. Emergency number +599 9 565 1776.
entries.note: Own site. Emergency number published but no 24 h wording, so emergency_24h=false.

duty_i18n.cs: Recepce Po–Pá 9:00–14:00, so 9:00–13:00, v neděli zavřeno. Pouze na objednání; návštěvy doma v úterý a v pátek. Pohotovostní číslo +599 9 565 1776.
duty_i18n.sv: Receptionen har öppet mån–fre 9.00–14.00, lör 9.00–13.00, stängt på söndagar. Endast efter tidsbokning; hembesök tisdagar och fredagar. Akutnummer +599 9 565 1776.
duty_i18n.da: Receptionen man–fre 9.00–14.00, lør 9.00–13.00, lukket søn. Kun efter aftale; hjemmebesøg tirsdage og fredage. Akutnummer +599 9 565 1776.
duty_i18n.fi: Vastaanotto ma–pe klo 9.00–14.00, la klo 9.00–13.00, su suljettu. Vain ajanvarauksella; kotikäynnit tiistaisin ja perjantaisin. Päivystysnumero +599 9 565 1776.

notes: Only one clinic confirmed from an acceptable source. No Curacao veterinary association, Veterinary Service (LVV) contact page or duty rota found. Unreachable/blocked: facebook.com pages (Claus Clinic, Vlimmen/De Geus, VetDoest; robots), animalscaribbean.com (robots), cybo.com (error), licg.nl PDF (error), curacao.com pet page (provenance), vetdrvinck.com (Bluehost account suspended). Not covered: Centro Veterinario Dr. E.G. Vinck, Klinika Veterinaria Parera, Claus Clinic, Vlimmen Veterinary Services (only seen via search results/Facebook).
